source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
Once per battle for each unit with this ability, as this unit finishes a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)** in your Movement phase, you can pick 1 enemy unit it can see within 12" and roll a D6. On a 3+, deal D3 **[mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)** to the picked unit.

Keep a Bomb Squig token beside the unit until it uses this ability.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 8 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

detail.timing: own normal move end in own Movement phase
detail.marker: a Bomb Squig token beside the unit, removed when the ability is used
